context:
Goal: new open questions come first (your comment on item 309, 15:44 CST).
Problem (rule): the only way to keep every open card above every answered card at all times is to re-sort on each Send. That breaks rule ux-order-holds-still: cards never move under your pointer.
Based on (read): in page.html, freezeSunk keeps the cards you sent this visit in place until the page reloads.
Departs from: main sorts a new item by rank and age, below the cards sent this visit — new items go on top (a), or sent cards drop on each Send (b).
Meanwhile: the lane builds a. Mockup: branch page-lane-answered-sinks, docs/design/lane-answered-sink.html.
holds: Where a new question lands on the page.

options.gain: New questions show first, and no card jumps when you Send.
options.how: An item that arrives after the page loads goes to the top of its tier.
options.label: Arrivals on top
options.lose: A card that was open since you loaded the page can sit below one you already sent.

options.gain: Answered cards are always below open ones.
options.how: Each Send moves the sent card below every open card.
options.label: Sent cards drop
options.lose: Each Send moves cards under your pointer.

ref: item 309 comment; step page-answered-sink; lane page-answered-sink
reply: You picked neither: the order rule was applied too strictly. Home: step page-answered-sink (PR #1373), and your 313 a narrowed the rule. Closed 12:12 CST Nov 7.
title: New questions first (your comment on item 309): put new arrivals on top, or drop sent cards below open ones?
why: Keeping every open card above every sent card means cards move under your pointer each time you Send.
